question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Placate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1: Appease**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Placate"** means to calm, soothe, or pacify someone, especially by making concessions or giving in to their demands. (शांत करना, तुष्ट करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The manager tried to placate the angry customers by offering them a discount on their next purchase.
 
 
 
• **"Appease"** means to pacify or soothe someone by acceding to their demands or by making them feel content. (सांत्वना देना, तुष्ट करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The government took steps to appease the protestors by addressing their grievances.
 
 
 
• Both words, "Placate" and "Appease," are synonyms as they share a similar meaning of calming or pacifying someone.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1: Appease**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Infuriate** (क्रोधित करना): To make someone extremely angry or enraged.

 
 
• **Example:** The delay in the flight infuriated the passengers waiting at the airport.
 
 
 
• **Serve** (सेवा करना): To perform duties or provide assistance to someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The waiter served our meals with a smile.
 
 
 
• **Bother** (परेशान करना): To annoy or cause inconvenience to someone.
 
 
• **Example:** I didn’t want to bother her with my problems while she was busy.
 
 

3c:Tb4b,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
